channel.title: saavn_play Changelog
channel.description: Changelog for saavn_play - Dart API Client for JioSaavn

item.title: saavn_play v1.3.0
item.description:
v1.3.0 - January 15, 2025

  • Added: New Podcast API for discovering top shows
  • Added: Radio API for accessing radio stations and streaming content
  • Added: Lyrics API for fetching song lyrics with copyright info
  • Added: Playlist API for getting playlist details and featured lists
  • Added: Home endpoint for launch data with trending modules and charts
  • Added: Interactive API playground for testing endpoints
  • Added: Batch request support for multiple API calls
  • Added: Request history and collections features
  • Changed: Improved error handling with detailed error messages
  • Changed: Enhanced type safety across all models
  • Fixed: Resolved timeout issues on large search results
  • Fixed: Fixed null safety issues in Artist model

item.title: saavn_play v1.2.0
item.description:
v1.2.0 - November 20, 2024

  • Added: Artist API with profile, songs, and albums support
  • Added: ArtistPageDetails typed response model
  • Added: Social links extraction for artist profiles
  • Added: Language and dominant type fields for artists
  • Changed: Refactored search to support pagination parameters
  • Changed: Updated Song model with additional metadata fields
  • Fixed: Fixed album track listing order inconsistency
  • Fixed: Resolved image URL encoding issues

item.title: saavn_play v1.1.0
item.description:
v1.1.0 - September 10, 2024

  • Added: Album API with detailed album information
  • Added: Album recommendations endpoint
  • Added: Song recommendations based on listening history
  • Added: Cover art and image URL support for albums
  • Changed: Improved search result accuracy
  • Changed: Enhanced error messages for API failures
  • Fixed: Fixed client connection pooling issues

item.title: saavn_play v1.0.0
item.description:
v1.0.0 - July 1, 2024

  • Added: Initial release of saavn_play package
  • Added: Search API for songs, albums, artists, and playlists
  • Added: Song details API with comprehensive metadata
  • Added: SaavnPlayClient with configurable base URL
  • Added: Full type safety with Dart 3.x support
  • Added: MIT License for open source usage
